name: DinPuls
subtitle: Din kommun, samlat
description: DinPuls samlar lokal information för din kommun. Hitta nyheter, evenemang, lunch, föreningar och praktisk vardagsinformation. Välj kommun och anpassa startsidan genom att gömma moduler som du inte är intresserad av. Notiser är frivilliga och anpassas efter dina val.
reviewNotes: Municipality is selected manually. Core public information does not require an account. Native push, local module preferences, external source links and PDF sharing are supported. Company-account tests use an isolated backend; a separate review account must be provided before submission.
submissionBlocks: Apple Developer membership, signed distribution build and TestFlight setup
Firebase iOS registration, APNs credential upload and physical-device push test
Physical iPhone verification including keyboard, file selection and sharing
Resolve in-app advertising purchases under App Review Guideline 3.1.3(g); no App Store approval claimed
Verify account-deletion flow, App Privacy declarations, age rating and rights to submitted icon/media before submission
